name: Ego-Exo4D: Understanding Skilled Human Activity from First- and Third-Person Perspectives
description: Ego-Exo4D is a massive multi-modal benchmark capturing skilled human activity simultaneously from first-person (egocentric) and multiple third-person (exocentric) viewpoints. Created by Meta AI and a global university consortium, it features 1,422 hours of synchronized video across 5,035 takes capturing complex sports, music, cooking, and healthcare procedures with 3D pose, eye gaze, and language narrations.
